facts.fact: The Federal Government and the EU inaugurated a 2.7 million pound, three-year Earth Observation agricultural project run by NASRDA and the European Space Agency, with demonstration farms in seven states and an open-source agricultural information system to be built integrating satellite data and ground sensors.

NGA.note: Nothing on AI rules or harms.
AI is for farming advice, not general administration.

facts.fact: NASRDA said farmers in seven demonstration states would be supported with AI-based tools for data collection and analysis, and the project's expert said the planned information system would include voice-based AI advisory services.

NGA.note: No AI model, dataset or computing facility stated; the system is planned.
